sources.title: An alternative "description of personality": The Big-Five factor structure
sources.author: Lewis R. Goldberg
sources.claims_supported: Five-factor lexical structure as general background
sources.limitation: Does not validate FermatMind's instrument, scoring, norms, or interpretation

sources.title: The next Big Five Inventory (BFI-2): Developing and assessing a hierarchical model with 15 facets
sources.author: Christopher J. Soto; Oliver P. John
sources.claims_supported: One established 60-item operationalization of five domains and 15 facets
sources.limitation: BFI-2 structure must not be attributed to another instrument without mapping evidence

sources.title: Big Five Inventory
sources.author: Berkeley Personality Lab
sources.claims_supported: BFI/BFI-2 forms, timing and instrument documentation
sources.limitation: Official BFI resource, not FermatMind product documentation

sources.title: ITC Guidelines on Test Use, version 1.2
sources.author: International Test Commission
sources.claims_supported: Interpretation should be appropriate to intended use and evidence; avoid over-generalization
sources.limitation: General guideline, not an instrument validation study

sources.title: ITC Guidelines for Translating and Adapting Tests, second edition
sources.author: International Test Commission
sources.claims_supported: Translation alone is not sufficient evidence of cross-language equivalence
sources.limitation: Does not establish parity for FermatMind EN/ZH instruments

sources.title: FermatMind Public Claim Runtime Boundary Matrix
sources.author: FermatMind repository governance
sources.claims_supported: Big Five may describe traits/workplace tendencies but is not a precise career matching engine
